name: PDF Compressor
description: WASM-powered PDF Compressor. Shrinks PDF file sizes by optimizing internal images without rasterizing the document.

howToUse:
1. Drop your PDF file into the workspace.
2. Select your compression preset (Lossless, Balanced, Max).
3. Wait for the processing to complete.
4. Download the optimized PDF.
features:
• No Rasterization
• Text Remains Selectable
• On-Device Processing
